recommendations.title: Direct net ADR is Rs 5,346.82/night - Rs 1,254.69/night more than OTA Alpha
recommendations.action: Test moving a portion of OTA Alpha inventory to direct. Run it in the Channel Mix Simulator and read the demand-at-risk figure alongside the gain - the gap between them is the part of this recommendation that is an assumption, not an observation.
recommendations.evidence: Direct Website net ADR Rs 5,346.82 over 5,350 room nights (gross ADR Rs 5,578.66, distribution cost Rs 1,240,347.22, i.e. 4.16% of gross). Against it, Travel Agent, OTA Alpha, Corporate, OTA Beta net ADRs are Rs 4,625.28, Rs 4,092.13, Rs 4,435.27, Rs 3,880.58. Room nights currently sold through those channels: 9,494. Observed ADR gap on those nights: Rs 11,098,702.38 - an upper bound on what perfect channel discipline would be worth, NOT a forecast.
recommendations.assumption: No assumption that any of those guests would have booked direct. The figure states the size of the gap, not that it is capturable.
recommendations.expected_impact: Closing even part of this gap is the single largest net revenue lever visible in the observed data.

recommendations.title: Deterministic scenario reallocation: modelled net revenue increase of Rs 1,234,579.19
recommendations.action: Reproduce this allocation in the Channel Mix Simulator, then stress it: raise the demand-at-risk assumption and watch the result move. Only commit inventory once the modelled gain survives a pessimistic arrival rate.
recommendations.evidence: Scenario 'Greedy reallocation (max net revenue)' moves 7,867 single-night shifts under the objective MAXIMIZE_NET_REVENUE. Gross Rs 85,893,217.45, distribution cost Rs 5,923,286.21 (6.90%), net Rs 79,969,931.24 vs baseline Rs 78,735,352.05. Modelled lost demand 1,435 nights; modelled direct gain 5,022 nights.
recommendations.assumption: Depends entirely on the stated assumptions: conversion rates CORPORATE 18.00%, OTA_ALPHA 34.00%, OTA_BETA 29.00%, TRAVEL_AGENT 21.00%, max shift fraction 30.00%. The allocator is a greedy heuristic, not a proven optimum.

recommendations.title: Renegotiate OTA Alpha commission - it takes 23.99% of bookings but returns only 20.17% of net revenue
recommendations.action: Open a commercial review of the OTA Alpha contract. Commission is 59.45% of this channel's distribution cost, so renegotiating the rate is the largest single lever; the alternatives are a deeper rate/card discount structure or moving volume to direct. Test any change in the Channel Mix Simulator before committing inventory.
recommendations.evidence: 1,116 bookings, 3,880 room nights, Rs 21,138,905.70 gross. Distribution cost Rs 5,261,451.06 (24.89% of gross; 36.86% of the hotel's total distribution cost). Commission Rs 3,128,031.34 (59.45% of that cost), discount Rs 1,690,553.63, payment fees Rs 442,866.09, other Rs 0.00. Net revenue Rs 15,877,454.64; net ADR Rs 4,092.13 vs gross ADR Rs 5,448.17 (ADR penalty Rs 1,356.04/night). Booking share 23.99%, net revenue share 20.17%, share gap 3.82%.
recommendations.assumption: Assumes a commission reduction is negotiable at all. No contractual term has been verified.
recommendations.expected_impact: A 1 percentage-point reduction in the effective commission rate on this channel's gross revenue is worth Rs 211,389.06 net, holding volume constant.

recommendations.title: Convert 34.00% of OTA Alpha's volume to direct - modelled Rs 1,655,188.37 net gain
recommendations.action: Run a direct-booking campaign on OTA Alpha volume: rate parity, a direct-booking benefit, and a booking-engine nudge on OTA Alpha pages. Treat Rs 1,655,188.37 as the modelled ceiling under the stated 34.00% conversion assumption, not as a committed saving.
recommendations.evidence: OTA Alpha: 3,880 room nights, net ADR Rs 4,092.13/night, Rs 15,877,454.64 net revenue. Applying the hotel-supplied direct conversion rate of 34.00% to 3,880 nights yields 1,319 convertible nights. Direct net ADR is Rs 5,346.82/night, a difference of Rs 1,254.69/night, so 1,319 x Rs 1,254.69 = Rs 1,655,188.37 modelled additional net revenue.
recommendations.assumption: Assumes the hotel's stated 34.00% direct conversion rate for OTA Alpha holds, and that direct capacity exists to absorb 1,319 additional nights. Neither has been verified against booking behaviour.
